title: Nice, shrinks allot,  hem and all stitching curls after washing.
text:
Nice, shrinks allot, hem and all stitching curls after washing.. Nice lite blue color. Runs big till you wash this apron, even the pocket got allot smaller, although love the pocket.
I'm 5'2' but the tie still comes below my waist. If I bring this up higher to tie it around my waist, it then
Covers the pocket.
I did tightened it at the top,
That said i can still use this apron. Good for BBQing .

If I liked to iron my aprons this would look better.
The hem, and all the stitching curls up after washing.
It would lay flat if this cotton fabric was pre washed.

I'm sure this would fit a man or a taller person better then me.
